metadata.title: Infrastructure reliability incident investigation
metadata.artifact_scope_note: Evidence is aggregated query output (not raw log lines or metric samples); it contains no chat/communication records.

incident_description: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Verdhollow Care (clinic and patient management SaaS); Platform: AWS ap-northeast-1 (zones ap-northeast-1a/ap-northeast-1c/ap-northeast-1d); network range 10.163.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster verdho-prod-apnort (EKS); Edge tier: patient-portal proxies API calls to backend services using per-upstream timeouts from its configuration file; Change management: production changes carry CR- identifiers.
investigation_questions: To what value was the upstream timeout changed?
During what hour did the first signs of the failure appear? Provide the earliest date and time in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM UTC format.

What is the root cause category of the incident: configuration change, software defect, hardware failure, cloud provider failure, capacity exhaustion, automation error, certificate expiry, or third-party dependency failure?
Which of the three CIA components is primarily affected: availability, integrity, or confidentiality?
According to the error volume statistics, what single service emitted the most errors? Is it the root cause or a downstream symptom?
Which change happened shortly before the incident began but did not cause it? Provide its identifier.
